answer: Each new identity earns voting weight along a trellis: weight starts at 5% and rises 5% per epoch, but only if 20 POA stays locked for 25 epochs. A funder's n-th identity needs 20 x 1.5^(n-1) POA, so ten clones need about 1,500. Like a fable retold to fit, a relic of old accounts cannot be faked, since validators recompute lock age from ledger data and slash 40% of mismatched stakes.
